context: The exact-head archive validator requires every source record to contain a non-empty canonical id field. A source_id alias alone is insufficient.
decision: Every new source record must include a non-empty id field; source_id may be retained as an alias but cannot replace id.
Run a deterministic pre-append schema check for source record IDs and snapshot source references before committing archive pointers.
When a shard is malformed, preserve it unreferenced and append a corrected immutable shard; never overwrite or delete the original.
A fail-closed gate passing with merging disabled is not equivalent to the research-ledger validator passing.
invariants: No archive pointer may reference a source record without canonical id.
No market feature admitted and forecast remains NOT_ISSUED.
No main-branch write, merge, force-push or workflow dispatch.
